note: Test-split delta residuals (realised - predicted CHANGE) and 80% split-conformal coverage by operating subgroup. A group is flagged as a COLLAPSE when n<100, coverage<0.70, or |bias| > 2x the noise floor. Over-coverage (>0.80) is conservative (safe) and reported but not flagged. Uniform fleet display is safe only if no subgroup collapses.
